question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported manifest for the experimental single-agent Claws lifecycle once its prerequisite stack is ready?
rationale: This is a new package-format and export-contract direction, not a repair to an established current-main behavior; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want this canonical authoring surface.

options.title: Sponsor the canonical format
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format after exact-head CLI round-trip proof and sequential landing of the prerequisite Claws lifecycle PRs.

options.title: Retain JSON as the only canonical format
options.body: Decline the new canonical export contract and keep the existing grouped JSON direction for the experimental lifecycle.

options.title: Pause the format decision
options.body: Defer this final stacked stage until the lifecycle stack and RFC direction receive explicit maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the canonical format
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format after exact-head CLI round-trip proof and sequential landing of the prerequisite Claws lifecycle PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed feature-history contact for the proposed stacked Claws format, though product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
